Law LLB at University of Exeter

What University of Exeter asks of applicants to Law LLB for 2027 entry (the 2026–27 application cycle). Each requirement below is labelled verified, partly verified or not verified, with the date it was checked and a link to the official source.

UK · All University of Exeter courses · Law field guide

Entry requirements 2027 entry 8 of 8 verified
SAT / ACT
  • For applicants with a US high-school diploma: an ACT composite or SAT score is one way to meet the A-level-equivalent requirement — ACT 31 or SAT 1400 (Exeter’s equivalents of AAA)
  • Any subject-specific requirements must be met with an AP test or college-level credit (this course lists none)
  • SAT/ACT is not required: three advanced classes (AP classes or tests, honours or college-level classes) are the alternative route
Verified19 Oct 2026Exeter: United States of America – entry requirements
English language
  • English language Profile B1
  • IELTS Academic: 6.5 overall and no less than 5.5 in any section
  • TOEFL iBT: 90 with minimum scores of 20 in speaking and 18 for writing, listening and reading
  • Pearson PTE Academic: 67 with no less than 59 in all communicative skills
Verified19 Oct 2026Exeter: LLB Law · Exeter: English Language Requirements – Profile B1

Other qualifications
  • Advanced Placement (for applicants with a US high-school diploma): three ‘advanced classes’ — AP classes, AP tests, honours or college-level classes, in any combination — at grade A / AP 5 for the AAA typical offer (Exeter’s table: AP test 5 = A-level A, 4 = B)
